messages:
luca: heads up — had to settle an emergency generator repair at the Dublin colo this AM. corpcard declined with fraud block. paid on personal Visa. invoice: https://invoices.redwood.com/INV-2026-221.pdf total EUR 2,750.00. vendor name & VAT on invoice. will be on a late flight tonight, can we do an expedited payback?
jess (Finance Ops): sorry about the card block — can you confirm vendor name + VAT ID and whether invoice is made out to Redwood Ireland Ltd? also upload the receipt screenshot to Expensify and tag `urgent` + cost center `ENG-INFRA`.
luca: vendor: Eurolink Data Services Ltd, VAT IE9876543A. invoice header shows "Redwood Inference Ireland Ltd". uploaded receipt here: https://expensify.com/receipts/def456. adding @mark to approve. note on expense: "critical HW repair - colo".
jess (Finance Ops): perfect. since invoice is to the company we can reimburse and reclaim VAT. for amounts over ,000 we'd need extra approvals, but this is below that. please add last4 of the card you want refunded to and set reimbursement type to "bank transfer" if you prefer.
mark (Eng Lead): approved. please include the payment confirmation screenshot and the technician sign-off note in the expense.
card-bot: CardBot: the corporate card was auto-blocked due to 3 unusual overseas transactions in 24h. to lift blocks in future request temporary international unblock via https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/TC-402. daily single-transaction limit is ,500.
jess (Finance Ops): started expedite path. accounting preview codes net EUR 2,350.42 and VAT EUR 399.58 (total EUR 2,750.00). can you confirm the invoice lines so the VAT calc matches?
luca: invoice lines copied from PDF:
```
Invoice INV-2026-221
Eurolink Data Services Ltd
Service: Emergency generator replacement + site labor (4h)
Net: ,350.42
VAT 17%: 399.58
Total: 2,750.00
```
jess (Finance Ops): small typo in copy (extra character). confirmed: Net ,350.42, VAT 99.58 matches our calc. please DM me preferred refund bank last4. i'll target same-day ACH if received before cut-off.
luca: DM sent with bank last4 7789. thanks all.
nina (People Ops): payroll/tax note: since vendor invoice is to company and VAT will be reclaimed, treat as non-taxable. also log on-site incident in the travel/incident tracker for insurance record.
jess (Finance Ops): accounting ref ACCT-2026-954, expedite flag set. payment target: same business day if bank details received by 16:00 UTC. i'll post update when payment originates. :white_check_mark:
